title: Configuration schema, merge, and migrations
objective: Implement versioned Global/Project config loading, merge/validation rules, immutable safety policy, and backup-first schema migration.
expected_output: recursive merge and immutable policy enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Project values override only supplied keys; objects merge recursively and arrays replace.
Safety invariants cannot be disabled by config.
Invalid known keys block before side effects; unknown keys warn.
Migration validates in staging, preserves backup, and rolls back on failure; semantic conflicts require approval.
undo_classification: Keep prior config and migration backup; restore only node-owned staged files.
approval_requirements: User approval for unresolved semantic migration conflicts.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; repeated identical failure escalates.
